name: joints
rows: Finger joints, CNC, snug: 0.2 mm gap at each joint face
Finger joints, CNC, easy: 0.4 mm gap at each joint face

name: cone_depth
expr: max(3 mm, min(0.32*cone_outer_radius, motor_front_depth - surround_crest_depth - cone_shell - 8 mm))

name: rear_cone_volume
expr: 2*pi*(rear_dish_y*(cone_outer_radius^2 - dust_cap_radius^2)/2 + (rear_rim_y - rear_dish_y)/(cone_outer_radius - dust_cap_radius)*((cone_outer_radius^3 - dust_cap_radius^3)/3 - dust_cap_radius*(cone_outer_radius^2 - dust_cap_radius^2)/2))

name: rear_chord_volume
expr: 2*pi*(rear_rim_y*(frame_ring_radius^2 - cone_outer_radius^2)/2 + (frame_ring_y - rear_rim_y)/(frame_ring_radius - cone_outer_radius)*((frame_ring_radius^3 - cone_outer_radius^3)/3 - cone_outer_radius*(frame_ring_radius^2 - cone_outer_radius^2)/2))

name: hole_air_volume
expr: pi*cutout_radius^2*board_thickness - rear_disk_volume - rear_cone_volume - rear_chord_volume - rear_ring_volume - rear_gap_volume

name: wants_brace
expr: height_before_brace >= 300 mm && (height_before_brace/2 - stack_height/2) >= board_thickness + 34 mm && depth_before_brace > 2*brace_width + 40 mm && width_before_brace > 2*brace_width + 40 mm

name: brace_z
expr: if(is_vented, port_center_z - port_mouth_radius - 12 mm - board_thickness, driver_center_z - flange_radius - 12 mm - board_thickness)

name: terminal_z
expr: min(outer_height - board_thickness - terminal_radius - 12 mm, max(0.3*outer_height, if(wants_brace, brace_z + board_thickness + terminal_radius + 12 mm, 0 mm)))

name: port_velocity_at_xmax
label: Port air speed at Xmax (m/s, 0 when sealed)

name: tuned_frequency_measured
label: Tuning from the measured air (Hz, 0 when sealed)

name: sealed_qtc_measured
label: Sealed Qtc from the measured air (0 when vented)

name: out_port_length
label: Port length, mouth to inner end (0 when sealed)

name: out_rebate_w
label: Rebate width, one board (0 when finger jointed)

name: out_rebate_d
label: Rebate depth, half a board (0 when finger jointed)

name: out_pipe_resonance
label: First port pipe resonance (Hz, cross over well below it; 0 when sealed)

name: Net air volume within 0.25 % of the target (measured on the sealed model)
Vented: transfer function is 3 dB down at the reported f3
Port tube outside diameter on the model equals the design
Port length on the model equals the design
Port wall section leaves the bore 17 m/s needs at Xmax (measured)
Port end stays one diameter from the back wall
Port mouth clears the bottom board
Brace stays clear of the bottom board
Brace does not overlap a board
plate_side_area
expr: if(is_finger, outer_depth*outer_height - 2*board_thickness*((finger_count_high + 1)/2*finger_pitch_high + finger_fit*(finger_count_high - 1)) - board_thickness*(finger_count_deep - 1)*(finger_pitch_deep + 2*finger_fit) - 2*(finger_count_high + finger_count_deep - 2)*bone_area, outer_depth*outer_height)

name: plate_bottom_area
expr: if(is_finger, outer_width*outer_depth - 2*board_thickness*((finger_count_wide + 1)/2*finger_pitch_wide + finger_fit*(finger_count_wide - 1)) - 2*board_thickness*((finger_count_deep + 1)/2*finger_pitch_deep + finger_fit*(finger_count_deep - 1)) - 2*(finger_count_wide + finger_count_deep - 2)*bone_area, (outer_width - board_thickness)*(outer_depth - board_thickness))

name: Cut plates fit together without overlap
Plate cutout is concentric with the driver's frame, 1 mm clear
Plate port hole is concentric with the port bore, one wall clear
Terminal cup fits the back plate's hole
Baffle plate: section equals its closed form
Back plate: section equals its closed form
Side plate: section equals its closed form
Bottom plate: section equals its closed form
Boards counted: six panels, plus the brace when there is one
Finger joints: no finger under three quarters of a board wide
port_limit_diameter
expr: max(30 mm, min(150 mm, min(0.33*estimate_width, 0.92*depth_with_large_port + board_thickness - 5 mm - port_length_min)))

name: xmax_ceiling
expr: if(is_vented, max(5 mm, min(largest_fit_diameter, port_limit_diameter) - 1 mm)^2*port_velocity_limit/(8*port_tuning*per_second*cone_area), 15 mm)

name: alignment
label: Box alignment
description: Sealed or vented; the alignment sets the box volume and, vented, the tuning. QB3 is the flat Thiele vented alignment, sealed Butterworth the usual sealed box

name: driver_fs
label: Fs, free-air resonance (Hz)
description: From the data sheet. The form limits Fs so the port tube stays short enough for the cabinet and long enough to work

name: driver_qts
label: Qts, total Q
description: From the data sheet; the range is what each alignment can use

name: driver_vas
label: Vas, equivalent volume
description: From the data sheet. The range keeps the net volume between 5 and 120 litres

name: driver_sd
label: Sd, cone area (cm2)
description: From the data sheet; it limits the air the port must carry and sizes the cone in the model

name: driver_xmax
label: Xmax, one-way linear excursion
description: From the data sheet. Sets the port diameter from the air speed limit

name: driver_cutout
label: Baffle cutout diameter
description: The hole the driver's basket drops into
max: max(60 mm, min(400 mm, sqrt(net_volume_target/(100 mm)) - 2*baffle_margin - 30 mm))

name: driver_flange
label: Frame outer diameter
description: The driver's overall diameter; the baffle gets a rebate this size so the driver sits flush

name: driver_depth
label: Mounting depth
description: From the baffle's front face to the back of the magnet
max: max(driver_depth_floor, min(350 mm, 0.92*depth_after_stack + board_thickness - back_clearance - 8 mm))

name: board_thickness
label: Board thickness, measured
description: Your sheet's real thickness: every joint and the inner sizes follow it

name: proportion
label: Cabinet proportions
description: Height to width to depth; unequal sides spread the standing waves out

name: joint
label: Joint and machine
description: Finger joints with dog-bone corners for a CNC router, snug or easy fit; or rebated edges for a table saw or router (the outputs give the blanks and the rebates)

title: Loudspeaker box
description: A cabinet for one driver, from its data sheet: Fs, Qts, Vas, Sd, Xmax, baffle cutout, frame diameter and depth. Choose sealed or vented; the volume is computed from Thiele and Small's alignments, the net air is measured on the sealed model, and a vented box gets a flared port tuned by Helmholtz with end correction. To cut it: File > Export..., format DXF or SVG, Sheet of set: Cut sheet (one through-cut outline per board, the finger joints with their fit and dog-bones already in it); the set Rebate and mouth pockets holds the driver rebate and port mouth circles to pocket. For rebated joints the outputs give each blank and the rebate.
